lab.name: Energy and Polymer Research Lab
lab.description: Focused on high-entropy doping, agricultural-waste green chemistry, hydrothermal synthesis, electrodeposition, co-precipitation, thermal treatment, XRD, SEM(EDS), FT-IR, Raman, and SP-50e electrochemical analysis (CV, LSV, GCD, EIS).

features.title: Synthesis & Tuning
features.description: Hydrothermal, electrodeposition, co-precipitation, and calcination/annealing routes for energy materials.

features.title: Characterization
features.description: XRD, SEM(EDS), FT-IR, and Raman to build a strong structure-property evidence chain.

features.title: Electrochemical Platform
features.description: Use the SP-50e platform for CV, LSV, GCD, and EIS to assess storage performance.
